title: Chunk Metadata — Spec 036 amend-loop authoritative wire shape
description: Spec-036 amend-loop authoritative wire shape for a single AI Search index document under `corpus-v{N}`. EXTENDS the chunk shape inlined in `data-model.md §Chunk` and `contracts/retrieval-service.md` with the R3-amend-loop fields introduced by Clusters A1 (agency disambiguation), A3 (Commonwealth precedence), A2 (cultural classification gating), and A7 (alias-name capture for audit replay). Schema migration MUST follow the blue-green rebuild path per Pass 2 Q-P2-01 — never in-place — because legacy chunks lacking the new required fields would silently fail FR-RAG-AG-04 + SC-013 + SC-015.

chunk_id.description: UUID-v5 of `(corpus_entry_id, page, chunk_offset_in_page)` for stable identity across re-runs. AI Search index key.

tokens.description: Post-tokeniser count; ≤ 1024 (R-04). Ingest emits a chunk_size_tokens histogram and CI fails if any chunk > 1024.

embedding_model_id.description: E.g. `text-embedding-3-large`. Exactly one distinct value per `corpus-v{N}` index (R-05 signal 4).

summary.description: Conditionally present iff `licence_mode == 'metadata-only'` (no body, just publisher-supplied summary).

cross_page.description: true iff this chunk overlaps a page boundary (R-04).

agency.description: Spec-036 amend-loop NEW field (Cluster A1). E.g. 'NSW-RFS', 'FRNSW', 'DFES-WA', 'SAMFS', 'NTES'. Drives FR-RAG-AG-04 disambiguation across multi-agency jurisdictions. Required for SC-013 ≥95% on agency-disambiguation subset of `tests/fixtures/golden-set-v1.json`.

agency_role.description: Spec-036 amend-loop NEW field (Cluster A1). Distinguishes urban-fire (FRNSW, FRV, SAMFS) from rural-fire (NSW RFS, CFA-VIC, SACFS, Bushfires NT) within shared jurisdictions, and SES from combined-agency (DFES-WA).

authority_level.description: Spec-036 amend-loop NEW field (Cluster A3). Drives FR-RAG-AC-01 + FR-RAG-COMP-04 precedence ranking (Commonwealth wins for national institutions in ACT).

precedence_rank.description: Spec-036 amend-loop NEW field (Cluster A3). 1=highest, 3=lowest. ACT-Commonwealth coexistence: Commonwealth=1, ACT=2 for national institutions. When two chunks share `precedence_rank`, the deterministic tie-break order from Pass 1 Q-P1-02 + ADR-13 applies.

precedence_tiebreak_applied.description: Optional. Trace of which tie-breakers were applied during ranking. Recorded in audit log so SC-011 ≥95% byte-identical replay holds even when ranks tie. Empty list when no tie occurred. Order matches the Pass 1 Q-P1-02 sequence.

cultural_classification.description: Spec-036 amend-loop NEW field (Cluster A2). `public` is the default and always retrievable; `indigenous-language` / `sacred-site` / `land-governance` are gated by `cultural_authority_required: true` and the post-retrieval cultural-authority gate per ADR-12.

cultural_authority_required.description: Spec-036 amend-loop NEW field (Cluster A2). When true, the cultural-authority gate (ADR-12) MUST verify operator consent in the `culturalAuthorityRegistry` Cosmos container before this chunk is surfaced. When the registry is unreachable at retrieval time, the gate fails closed and emits `cultural_authority_registry_unavailable` to the audit log (Pass 1 Q-P1-01).

retrieval_index_name.description: Spec-036 amend-loop NEW field (Cluster A7). The concrete AI Search index name (e.g. `corpus-v3`) NOT the alias (`corpus-search`). Resolved at query start by the retrieval client per FR-RAG-IDX-04a; recorded on every chunk surfaced through retrieval and propagated to `AuditRecord.retrieval_index_name` so audit replay can pin to the exact index version even after the alias has flipped (per ADR-16).

allOf.$comment: metadata-only → summary required; text + embedding forbidden.
cultural-authority gate (Cluster A2). cultural_classification != 'public' → cultural_authority_required MUST be true. ADR-12 enforces the runtime gate; this schema enforces the data-model invariant.
